name: Being Cruel
overview: Scripture reveals that cruelty harms both others and oneself, as the cruel bring trouble upon their own flesh while the merciful benefit their own soul (Proverbs 11:17). Believers are warned to avoid close associations with anger and fury, which often lead to cruel actions (Proverbs 22:24). The Lord commands justice and righteousness, urging His people to protect the vulnerable and refrain from violence or wrongdoing toward strangers, the fatherless, and widows (Jeremiah 22:3). Ultimately, evil originates in the heart, producing acts such as murder and cruelty, but Christ exemplifies forgiveness even toward those who act cruelly, praying for their pardon despite their ignorance (Mark 7:21; Luke 23:34).
